weapons.notes: 可点燃僵尸。初始装填 100 发，无法补充；火焰狂人初始持有时可充能。
weapons.englishNotes: Ignites zombies. Comes preloaded with 100 charges that cannot be refilled. Pyromaniacs start with this weapon (rechargable).

weapons.notes: 可快速伤害僵尸。攻击时每 40 个游戏刻（0.67 秒）消耗 1 单位燃料，闲置时每 160 个游戏刻（2.67 秒）消耗 1 单位燃料。
weapons.englishNotes: Rapidly damages zombies. Expends fuel at a rate of 1 unit every 40 game ticks (or 0.67 seconds) while attacking and 1 unit every 160 ticks (2.67 seconds) while idle.

weapons.notes: 轻便且击退能力不错。运动员可能初始持有；Roller Derby Girl 初始持有。

weapons.englishNotes: A good medium weapon. Anime Fans start with this weapon.

weapons.notes: 优秀的中等重量武器。Blade Master 在蓄满 COOL IT 时会免费赠予队伍一把骑士剑。Knight 初始持有；拥有「招牌武器」特质的幸存者可能初始持有。
weapons.englishNotes: A great medium-weight weapon. Blade Master will give the party a knight sword for free with a full charge COOL IT. Knight starts with this weapon. Survivors with Trademark Weapon may start with this weapons.

weapons.notes: Herman 初始持有。若通过「Cursed Treasure」文本事件获得，会永久绑定给选择拿取它的角色，并将该角色的背包容量设为 1 格；该角色身上的其他占格物品会移入汽车库存。
weapons.englishNotes: Herman starts with this weapon. If obtained by the Cursed Treasure text event, it will permanently lock the Claymore to the character you chose to have take it, and set that character's inventory space to 1 slot. Note that any item that takes up inventory on the character will be moved to the car inventory.

weapons.notes: 优秀的重型武器，比其他超重武器更轻。购买前选择“要求演示”可将价格降至 30 食物。
weapons.englishNotes: A great heavy weapon being lighter than other massive-weight weapons. Price can be reduced to 30 food if the player "asks for a demo" before buying it.

weapons.notes: 命中时会在小范围内造成范围伤害。Hermit 和火焰狂人初始持有。
weapons.englishNotes: Deals area-of-effect damage within small area on hit. Hermit and Pyromaniac start with this weapon.

weapons.notes: 在「Horrible Weather」事件中减少士气损失。幸存者可能随机初始持有。
weapons.englishNotes: Reduces morale loss during the Horrible Weather event. Survivors may randomly start with this weapon.

weapons.notes: 在「Horrible Weather」事件中减少士气损失。
weapons.englishNotes: Reduces morale loss during the Horrible Weather event.

weapons.notes: 极为轻便，击退能力和攻击距离都不错。运动员可能初始持有。
weapons.englishNotes: A super-lightweight weapon with good knockback and good reach. Athletes may start with this weapon.

weapons.notes: 体育用品店的稀有战利品。优秀的轻型武器，击退能力和攻击距离都不错。
weapons.englishNotes: Rare loot of Sporting Goods Store. A great lightweight weapon with good knockback and good reach.

weapons.notes: 拥有极高击退和额外命中数。DSYP 与 Kepa 初始持有。
weapons.englishNotes: Has massive knockback and extra hits. DSYP and Kepa start with this weapon.

weapons.englishNotes: A powerful medium-heavy weapon with good reach. A great weapon for characters with 6 Strength and 6 Fitness.

weapons.notes: Tortuga 初始持有。拥有特殊攻击动画。
weapons.englishNotes: Tortuga starts with this weapon. Has a special attack animation.

weapons.notes: 轻便且击退能力不错。是棒球棒的强化版。
weapons.englishNotes: A lightweight weapon with good knockback. Stronger version of Baseball Bat.

weapons.notes: 优秀的轻型武器，击退能力不错。是棒球棒的终极版。
weapons.englishNotes: A great lightweight weapon with good knockback. The ultimate version of Baseball Bat.

weapons.notes: 轻便且击退能力不错。
weapons.englishNotes: A lightweight weapon with good knockback.

weapons.notes: 可点燃僵尸和可燃物；在黑暗中发光。
weapons.englishNotes: Ignites zombies and flammable objects. Shines in darkness.

weapons.notes: 威力强大的中等重量武器。
weapons.englishNotes: A powerful weapon with medium weight.

weapons.notes: Pirate Captain 初始持有。
weapons.englishNotes: Pirate Captain starts with this weapon.

weapons.notes: 虽然沉重，但额外命中数不错、伤害较低。
weapons.englishNotes: Being heavy, has good extra hits but low damage.

weapons.notes: 可蓄力射出更强的一击。不会锁定僵尸。
weapons.englishNotes: Can be charged into a stronger shot. Doesn't lock on zombies.

weapons.notes: 比其他枪械更不容易吸引僵尸。
weapons.englishNotes: Attracts zombies less frequently than other firearms.

weapons.notes: 比其他枪械更不容易吸引僵尸。
weapons.englishNotes: Attracts zombies less frequently than other firearms.

weapons.notes: 比其他枪械更不容易吸引僵尸。
weapons.englishNotes: Attracts zombies less frequently than other firearms.

weapons.notes: 每次搜刮事件后充能。
weapons.englishNotes: Recharges after every looting event.

weapons.notes: 发射会弹跳的炮弹，炮弹在触地前会穿透僵尸。后坐力很高，会将射手击退。
weapons.englishNotes: Fires a bouncing cannonball that pierce through zombies until hitting the ground. Has high recoil that knocks the shooter back.

weapons.notes: 发射大型弹跳炮弹，炮弹在触地前会穿透僵尸。每次搜刮事件后充能。
weapons.englishNotes: Fires a large bouncing cannonball that pierce through zombies until hitting the ground. Recharges after every looting event.

weapons.notes: 将使用者传送至面对方向，并制造造成伤害的烟雾。提供小范围照明。Mad Scientist 初始持有时可充能。初始装填 5 发；免费获得时为 2 发。
weapons.englishNotes: Teleports user in direction they're facing; creates damaging puff of smoke. Provides a small area of illumination. Mad Scientist starts with this weapon (recharges). Preloaded with 5 charges; 2 charges if received for free.

weapons.notes: 可从远处快速伤害僵尸。攻击时每 3 秒消耗 1 单位燃料，闲置时每 30 秒消耗 1 单位燃料。
weapons.englishNotes: Rapidly damages zombies from a range. Expends fuel at a rate of 1 unit every 3 seconds while attacking and 1 unit every 30 seconds while idle.

weapons.notes: 击退并击倒僵尸。攻击时每 3 秒消耗 1 单位燃料，闲置时每 30 秒消耗 1 单位燃料。
weapons.englishNotes: Pushes away and knocks down zombies. Expends fuel at a rate of 1 unit every 3 seconds while attacking and 1 unit every 30 seconds while idle.

weapons.notes: Moody 携带时，每次搜刮任务后回复 20 发弹药。
weapons.englishNotes: Recharges 20 ammo after every looting mission when carried by Moody.

weapons.notes: 每次射击消耗两发霰弹。
weapons.englishNotes: Consumes two shells per shot.

weapons.notes: 可快速伤害僵尸。与链锯相比，伤害低 20%、燃料效率高 50%。永久绑定给被给予它的幸存者，但可被强盗抢走。
weapons.englishNotes: Rapidly damages zombies. Compared to Chainsaw, has 20% lower damage output and 50% better fuel efficiency. Permanently locked onto the survivor it is given to, but can be stolen by bandits.

weapons.notes: 每次使用消耗两发弹药。相比普通双管霰弹枪，伤害 +33%。
weapons.englishNotes: Consumes two ammunition per use. Has +33% damage comparing to normal double barrel shotgun.

weapons.notes: 安静，不会惊动僵尸。拥有「Bow and Arrows」特质的幸存者初始持有。
weapons.englishNotes: Silent; does not alert zombies. Survivors with Bow and Arrows start with this weapon.

weapons.notes: 安静，不会惊动僵尸。每次搜刮任务后回复 10 发弹药。
weapons.englishNotes: Silent; does not alert zombies. Recharges 10 ammo after every looting mission.

weapons.notes: 拥有「招牌武器」特质的幸存者可能初始持有。
weapons.englishNotes: Survivors with Trademark Weapon may start with this weapon.

weapons.notes: 可点燃僵尸。初始装填 500 发，无法补充。
weapons.englishNotes: Ignites zombies. Comes preloaded with 500 charges that cannot be refilled.

weapons.notes: 初始有 80 发电量。可快速伤害僵尸，但远弱于燃油链锯。
weapons.englishNotes: Starts with 80 charges. Rapidly damages zombies. Much weaker than gas-powered Chainsaw.

weapons.notes: 功能与电动链锯相同。
weapons.englishNotes: Functions the same as Electric Chainsaw.

weapons.notes: 发射触地爆炸的火箭。初始装填 3 发，无法补充；在 Prepper Paradise 获得时为 8 发。
weapons.englishNotes: Fires rockets that explode upon hitting the ground. Comes preloaded with 3 charges that cannot be refilled, or 8 charges from Prepper Paradise.

weapons.notes: 发射触地爆炸的火箭。功能类似火箭炮，但容量更高。
weapons.englishNotes: Fires rockets that explode upon hitting the ground. Functions like a Bazooka with higher capacity.

weapons.notes: 发射触地一秒后爆炸的榴弹。初始装填 6 发，无法补充；在 Prepper Paradise 获得时为 15 发。
weapons.englishNotes: Fires grenades that explode a second after hitting the ground. Comes preloaded with 6 charges that cannot be refilled, or 15 charges from Prepper Paradise.

weapons.notes: 初始有 50 发电量。可快速伤害僵尸。攻击时每 3 秒消耗 1 单位燃料。
weapons.englishNotes: Starts with 50 charges. Rapidly damages zombies. Expends fuel at a rate of 1 unit every 3 seconds while attacking.

weapons.notes: 初始有 50 发电量。可击退并击倒僵尸。攻击时每 3 秒消耗 1 单位燃料。拥有「招牌武器（Inventive）」特质的幸存者初始持有。
weapons.englishNotes: Starts with 50 charges. Pushes away and knocks down zombies. Expends fuel at a rate of 1 unit every 3 seconds while attacking. Survivors with the Trademark Weapon (Inventive) perk start with this weapon.

weapons.notes: 五金店的稀有战利品。
weapons.englishNotes: Rare loot of Hardware Store.

weapons.notes: 喷出更大的火焰，点燃僵尸和物体，并在地面留下持续更久的火焰区域。初始装填 50 发，无法补充；在 Prepper Paradise 获得时为 100 发。火焰狂人初始持有时可充能。
weapons.englishNotes: Spits larger jets of flame which ignite zombies/objects and create longer lasting patches of fire on the ground. Comes preloaded with 50 charges that cannot be refilled, or 100 charges from Prepper Paradise. Pyromaniac and Pyromaniacs start with this weapon (rechargable).

weapons.notes: 瞄准型武器，伤害较低。
weapons.englishNotes: An aiming weapon with low damage.

weapons.notes: 瞄准型武器，伤害较低。
weapons.englishNotes: An aiming weapon with low damage.

weapons.notes: 瞄准型武器。
weapons.englishNotes: Aiming weapon.

weapons.notes: 瞄准型武器。
weapons.englishNotes: Aiming weapon.

weapons.notes: 瞄准型武器。
weapons.englishNotes: Aiming weapon.

weapons.notes: 轻便且击退能力不错。Fairy Queen 初始持有。
weapons.englishNotes: A lightweight weapon with good knockback. Fairy Queen starts with this weapon.

weapons.notes: 在积雪地形使用时会发射能击倒僵尸的雪球。
weapons.englishNotes: Launches snowballs that knock down zombies when used on snowy terrain.

weapons.notes: 威力强大、极为轻便的瞄准型武器。疲劳产生速度为正常的一半。提供小范围照明。
weapons.englishNotes: A powerful, super-lightweight aiming weapon. Causes fatigue at half the normal rate. Provides a small area of illumination.

weapons.notes: 向前冲刺出拳，对路径上的僵尸和物体造成伤害。按住攻击键最多可蓄力 3 次，提高拳击速度和距离；满蓄力时会自动发动。再次蓄力前有 1 秒冷却。
weapons.englishNotes: Dash punches forwards, damaging zombies and objects along the way. Can be charged up to 3 time by holding the fire button, which increases punch speed and distance. Will automatically active on full charge. Has a cooldown of 1 second before another punch can be charged.

weapons.notes: 跃入空中后猛砸地面，对使用者周围小范围内的僵尸和物体造成伤害。
weapons.englishNotes: Leaps into the air, then slams down onto the ground, damaging zombies and objects in a small area around the user.

weapons.notes: 安静，不会惊动僵尸。持续射击会提高射速和伤害。
weapons.englishNotes: Silent; does not alert zombies. Fire rate and damage increase with continuous firing.

weapons.notes: 在 2.5 秒内显著提高移动速度。会从墙壁反弹、击倒僵尸并推开家具。效果期间无法使用武器或拾取战利品，并会被迫持续向前移动。效果结束后使用者会有 1 秒虚弱期，期间不能使用、拾取或切换武器。
weapons.englishNotes: Significantly increases movement speed for 2.5 seconds. Will bounce off walls, knocks zombies down and pushes furnitures away. While the effect is active, the user cannot use weapons or pick up loot, and is forced to keep moving forwards. The user become vulnerable for a second after the effect, in which they cannot use, pickup or switch weapons.

weapons.notes: Dr. Hawke 初始持有。由她本人持有时，可消耗医疗用品治疗附近队友。
weapons.englishNotes: Dr. Hawke starts with this weapon. When held by herself, can consume Medical Supplies to heal teammates nearby.

weapons.notes: 可进行三连发射击。
weapons.englishNotes: Can fire in 3-round bursts.

weapons.notes: 射击技能提供的穿透加成会部分降低。可在 Harbour 箱子中找到；在使用 COOL IT（需要 cool-it 4 级以上）时完成 cop bandits 事件可获得。
weapons.englishNotes: Penetrate bonus from shooting skill is partially reduced. Can be found in Harbour crates. Reward from cop bandits event when using COOL IT (requires cool-it 4+).

weapons.notes: 泵动霰弹枪；每发霰弹射出 7 颗弹丸。可在 Harbour 箱子中找到；在使用 COOL IT（需要 cool-it 4 级以上）时完成 cop bandits 事件可获得。
weapons.englishNotes: Pump shotgun; fires seven pellets per shell. Can be found in Harbour crates. Reward from cop bandits event when using COOL IT (requires cool-it 4+).

weapons.notes: 命中时会产生地震，对大范围内所有僵尸造成伤害。
weapons.englishNotes: On hit, creates a quake that damages all zombies within a large area.

weapons.notes: Isabelle the Paladin 初始持有。拥有「招牌武器」和「英雄型」特质的角色初始持有。略强于骑士剑。
weapons.englishNotes: Isabelle the Paladin starts with this weapon. Character with Trademark Weapon and Hero Type start with this weapon. Slightly stronger than Knight Sword.

weapons.notes: 命中时会使敌人残废并减速。
weapons.englishNotes: Maims enemies on hit, slowing them.

weapons.notes: 装备时会播放音乐并强化队友，使其近战攻击造成小型暴击。手持时持续消耗充能；切换武器或充能耗尽时增益消失。耗尽后约 30 秒充能完成（Wiki 原文存疑）。武器本身属于近战武器，疲劳产生速度为正常的一半。
weapons.englishNotes: When equipped, plays music and buff your teammates, making their melee attacks deal minicrits. Constantly consume charges when held. Buff will lost when switching weapons or when charges run out. Takes 30 seconds to recharge after running out (?). The weapon itself functions as a melee weapon that causes fatigue at half the normal rate.

weapons.notes: 点燃角色周围的所有僵尸。初始有 1 次充能；每次任务后回复 1 次，最多储存 3 次。
weapons.englishNotes: Uses to ignite all zombies around the character. Starts with 1 charge, and recharge by 1 after each mission, up to 3 charges.

weapons.notes: Bayonetti 初始持有。
weapons.englishNotes: Bayonetti starts with this weapon.

weapons.notes: 突刺武器，疲劳产生速度为正常的一半。拥有「招牌武器」特质的角色可能初始持有。
weapons.englishNotes: Thrusting weapon that causes fatigue at half the normal rate. Characters with Trademark Weapon may start with this weapon.

weapons.notes: 拥有「招牌武器」和「Hyperfixated」特质的角色初始持有。拥有 40 次充能，命中可立即击杀僵尸；剩余充能时也是光源。每次命中消耗 1 次充能，每次任务后充能。疲劳产生速度为正常的一半。
weapons.englishNotes: Characters with Trademark Weapon and Hyperfixated start with this weapon. Has 40 charges, can kill zombies instantly on hit, as well as being a light source if there are charges left. Hitting target consumes 1 charge. Recharges after each mission. Causes Fatigue at half of the normal rate.

weapons.notes: 攻击距离不错的突刺武器。疲劳产生速度为正常的 66%。
weapons.englishNotes: Thrusting weapon with good reach. Causes fatigue at 66% of normal rate.
